common.pageDescription: Find emergency numbers and get clear, location-based guidance when you need help quickly.

home.serverUnavailableTitle: Server don't want to get up.
home.startBreath: Start by taking a deep breath
home.locationPrompt: Now, let me see your location.
home.disclaimerLocation: By clicking the button, you will be asked to share your location. We will only use this information to provide you with relevant emergency information.
home.disclaimerProject: This app is a personal project and the author of this app declines any responsibility for the accuracy of the information provided and any reliance on such information.
home.disclaimerWarning: Be aware that if you call an emergency number without a valid reason, you may be charged by the authority.
home.locationNotActiveDescription: You need to let me see where you are, otherwise I won't be able to give you the information.

emergency.title: Emergency Numbers
emergency.noNumbers: No emergency numbers found for this region.
emergency.callInfo: You can call the single emergency number for any need. The operator will then direct you to the right service for your case.
emergency.primaryCallInfo: You can call the single emergency number for any need. The operator will then direct you to the right service for your case.
emergency.policeCallInfo: Use this number to report a crime, request police assistance, report an imminent danger, or any situation requiring immediate police presence.
emergency.fireCallInfo: Use this number for fires, explosions, hazardous materials, rescue situations, or any emergency where the fire service is needed.
emergency.medicalCallInfo: Use this number for medical emergencies, sudden illness, accidents, serious injuries, or any situation requiring immediate healthcare support.
emergency.testNotice: This is a test website. Pressing Call will not place a real call.
emergency.beReady: Be ready: the operator will ask you what the emergency is, where you are, and how many people are involved.
emergency.dontHangUp: Don't hang up unless you're told to.
